name: FROST BITE
source:
FROST BITE is a horror erotica multi choice visual novel starring Tate Frost.

It's 1995 and you're driving alone the night before a big snow storm hits, snow is already building up around you and you've never been to this area of the woods before. The road is getting icy and you see a quaint grocery store shining bright on the dark forest road. It might be a good idea to stop for supplies.....

[From [url=https://masochistfox.itch.io/frost-bite]Itch.io[/url]]
